snippet.title: glass memory
snippet.description:
After a long time in the making of this project, it's finally here! 
Join the Patreon for exclusive content and updates on the upcoming game! https://www.patreon.com/c/snaptic

This animation showcases the gameplay and aesthetics that I intend to implement into the Snaptic game.
Now that this is complete, the main focus is producing the game!


Cast:
Anon - Corey LeVier
https://x.com/VoicesByCorey
Auralyn - Josephine Su
https://x.com/JosephineSuVA
Valence - Jacob Takanashi
https://x.com/xJ_Takax

Additional character animation by CamTheCan
https://www.x.com/CamTheCan

Anon & Auralyn Title Cards by Choco 
https://x.com/chocographix

Additional graphic design by 9redwoods
https://x.com/9redwoods

Thumbnail by Minimin
https://x.com/MiniminStudios


All animation, models, designs, scripts, and music created by me!


You can listen to the soundtrack on all platforms, titled “glass memory (Original Soundtrack)”!
https://open.spotify.com/album/2sWjrTU2bgmXMwf6dBoEKu
